items.title: Conrad "Connie" Jones Interview, 1981-09-01
items.q: Was it Black Joe who danced? No, no, he was a white guy.

ctx.x: Yeah. What was his son-in-law's name? Louis Mitro. D'Amico or something like that. He had a waiter that danced. Joe or something or another. Golly, I'm digging way down deep. He was the doorman at the show bar and is now a dancer. He would go up and work to the freezing room as a waiter on Sunday. And I saw Joe. Joe's got to be my age or maybe a couple of years older. And he went to show bars. And I can remember Joe standing up in front of the 500. Oh, who was the actor and the comedian at the 500? And Joe knew…
This is a white guy. Yeah. Was it Black Joe who danced? No, no, he was a white guy. And he's still alive you think.
Yeah, oh I saw him a couple of years ago. And he had his little grandson used to dance every once in a while. But I'm trying to think that pork chops and kidney stew come up there.
